impact: Legal risk adds to the board probe and congressional scrutiny, keeping a governance discount on NVDA into its Nov 17 earnings and a sentiment drag on AI chip holdings like MU and DRAM.
summary: A proposed securities class action filed Nov 9 in San Jose alleges Nvidia and CEO Jensen Huang misled shareholders by hiding his relationship with a woman US authorities consider a Chinese intelligence asset. It covers buyers from Oct 9, 2025 to Nov 8, 2026; Nvidia shares closed down 4.3% Monday, about $190B in value.
title: Nvidia and Huang hit with securities class action over spy ties
